verdict.rationale: Paddle documents an overlay checkout that "handles all parts of the checkout process — minimal frontend coding required," so developers avoid building their own payment UI. However, it is presented as an overlay via Paddle.js, not as a redirect to a standalone vendor-hosted checkout page, and nothing in the pack evidences conversion optimization. Missing for 10: documented redirect-to-hosted-page checkout (hosted checkout URL), evidence of conversion optimization, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can redirect customers to a vendor-hosted, conversion-optimized checkout page without building my own payment UI

citations.quote: Overlay checkout lets you present customers with an overlay that handles all parts of the checkout process — minimal frontend coding required.
Add a checkout to your app or website using Paddle.js to let customers buy one-time products and sign up for a subscriptions.
